'''Sana-Rae''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Voss|the planet of the same name]]. A [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]], she was also member of the [[Eternal Alliance]], leading its [[Force Enclave]], a school for the nurturing of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]' [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. She chose to join the enclave due to a vision, and sought to unite fellow Mystics, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] under the school's tutelage, as she believed in a balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Chapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref>

Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref>  Sana-Rae traveled to the planet [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] with [[Kira Carsen]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] to investigate the [[Temple of Nul|Temple]] of [[Darth Nul]].<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Being a Voss, and thus not aligned to either "side" of the Force, Sana-Rae was well respected by her peers, able to build up a coalition of Sith and Jedi alike, giving the Eternal Alliance a great advantage over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Force Adept|Force wielders]].
